description: Press a key or shortcut such as Enter, Tab, Escape, ArrowDown or Control+A. Optional selector or a11y ref is focused first; otherwise the key goes to the focused element on the selected page. Requires agent control in supervised sessions and uses click action permissions.

frame.description: A CSS selector for an iframe, or a list of them for nested iframes. selector, label and ref then resolve inside it.

key.description: Playwright key or combination, such as Enter, Escape or Control+A.

page_id.description: The page to act on, from list_pages or pages_opened. Defaults to the current page. Does not change the current page.

ref.description: An element ref from this page's latest get_a11y_tree, such as e5, or f1e3 inside an iframe.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to focus before pressing the key.

name: press
title: Press keyboard key
